scientific_integrity: All 65536 states of each named graph are covered by complete executable finite enumeration; no larger-graph extrapolation is asserted. Known generic and rook-only results are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the two named sixteen-vertex graphs and their synchronous open-neighborhood NOR dynamics. Known bipartite-double equivalence accounts for one-step invariants, and known NOR theory for the period bound; the new finite contribution is the paired attractor-basin table. Unindexed equivalent earlier results cannot be excluded. No independent external mathematical audit.
title: Same one-step NOR statistics, different attraction basins on the Shrikhande and rook graphs
